doc: What installs a theme name that a pair's asset list prefers (themes/*.json, assets.<mode>.gtkTheme / iconTheme / vscodeTheme as a list). themectl doctor and `themectl packages` read it; nothing here is ever installed by themectl. repo: extra = the official repositories (pacman), aur = the AUR (yay). A name with `build` has no package: the command builds it. A VS Code theme's name has `vscode`: the extension that brings it (`code --install-extension <id>`). The names are the directories the upstream install scripts make, checked 2026-11-08 against Colloid's and Tokyonight's install.sh at HEAD and the Catppuccin 1.0.3 release zips (their sha256 match the PKGBUILDs); not built here. Chosen for age and maintainer: every package has been in the AUR since 2024 or earlier.

catppuccin-latte-mauve-standard+default.note: catppuccin/gtk 1.0.3, the official palette, all 14 accents, GTK 3 and 4

catppuccin-macchiato-mauve-standard+defa.note: catppuccin/gtk 1.0.3, the official palette, all 14 accents, GTK 3 and 4

Tokyonight-Light.note: Fausto-Korpsvart's Tokyo Night, GTK 3 and 4; upstream renamed Tokyonight-GTK-Theme and archived 2025-10 (stable, no more changes); AUR since 2024-01

Colloid-Light-Everforest.note: Colloid with its Everforest scheme, GTK 3 and 4; Mark Wagie's split package (yochananmarqos, in the AUR since 2021); the same names without -git are a 2026-10 re-upload of it by a new account, 0 votes, release checksum SKIP

Colloid-Dark-Gruvbox.note: Colloid with its Gruvbox scheme, GTK 3 and 4

Colloid-Teal-Light.note: Colloid's own palette in its teal accent, GTK 3 and 4; every accent, light and dark

Colloid-Teal-Light-Everforest.note: Colloid's Everforest scheme in its teal accent (the pair's accent is Everforest's aqua)

Colloid-Teal-Dark-Gruvbox.note: Colloid's Gruvbox scheme in its teal accent

adw-gtk3.note: libadwaita's look for GTK 3, from the official repositories

catppuccin-macchiato-blue-standard+defau.note: Macchiato in its blue accent: the nearest ground to Night Owl's and to Tokyo Night Storm's (themes_coverage.md, 2026-11-08)

Paper.note: a VS Code theme: the Paper palette, light

Rosé Pine Dawn.note: a VS Code theme; the extension brings Moon too
